captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two identical, thin, rectangular sticks or bars positioned parallel to each other. They are plain, flat prisms with sharp rectangular edges and no visible surface engravings, holes, or additional features. The proportions are long and slender, resembling simple geometric slats or basic sticks.
captions.instruction: Design a pair of simple rectangular sticks in OpenSCAD. The script should define the length, width, and thickness of the sticks, placing them parallel to each other with an adjustable spacing parameter.
captions.factory: The code defines geometric helper modules from the 'Write.scad' library. To construct the physical sticks shown in the images, the script instantiates two parallel 'cube' primitives with custom dimensions. Each stick is positioned using 'translate' transforms to separate them by a defined gap along one axis.
